stories.title: Nissan considers Indian launch for Patrol SUV
stories.summary: Nissan is reportedly exploring a local launch for its flagship Patrol SUV as a completely built unit. The move marks a second attempt at the premium import market following the X-Trail, which the company noted did not meet performance expectations in India.

stories.summary: Bentley confirmed its first electric vehicle, the Torcal SUV, will arrive in India in late 2027. The company stated the vehicles will be fully built imports from its UK factory, regardless of any changes to import duties. Local assembly remains off the table for the luxury brand.

Electric two-wheeler sales reach record high during festive 2026

While the broader two-wheeler market grew by 3.67 percent, electric models accounted for an additional 125,473 units. The segment is currently outpacing the wider industry's growth rate.

stories.title: India’s three-wheeler exports surge 40 percent
stories.summary: India exported 365,217 three-wheelers between April and October 2026, a 39.9 percent increase from the 261,142 units recorded in the same period last year. Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, and Piaggio led the shipments to markets across Africa, Latin America, and Asia. Growth remains steady for the manufacturing hub.

stories.title: Bajaj Pulsar 125 Neon set for comeback in India
stories.summary: Bajaj is preparing to reintroduce the Pulsar 125 Neon to the Indian market. Spotted at a dealership in Krishnagiri, the bike is expected to sit below the new generation Pulsar 125 launched in August. It will likely feature traditional hardware and specifications to serve as an affordable option.

stories.title: Royal Enfield plans affordable 250cc bikes with hybrid technology
stories.summary: Royal Enfield is developing a range of 250cc motorcycles intended for first-time buyers. The new models are expected to be positioned below the company's existing 350cc lineup. The manufacturer is looking to expand its reach beyond the premium and larger engine motorcycles that currently define its portfolio.

stories.title: Suzuki Access scooters introduced in new colors
stories.summary: Suzuki Motorcycle India has added Metallic Royal Bronze and Metallic Matte Bordeaux Red to its Access scooter range. The new color options are available on select Ride Connect and TFT ABS variants starting November 23, 2026. Prices for the updated models begin at 83,086 rupees.

stories.title: Tata Nexon and MG Windsor EV set for major updates in 2027
stories.summary: Electric passenger vehicle sales in India reached 304,701 units between January 1 and November 9, 2026, a 66 percent annual increase. To maintain momentum, Tata and MG are planning updates for the Nexon EV and Windsor EV in 2027. The market is currently responding to rising demand.

stories.title: EVs are the festive showstoppers
stories.summary: India recorded 5.53 million automotive sales during the 2026 festive season, a 2.2 percent increase over last year. Electric vehicle retail sales surged 52.62 percent, crossing 500,000 units for the first time. The growth spanned two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, three-wheelers, tractors, and construction equipment.

Passenger EV market gears up for a big leap
stories.summary: BloombergNEF projects India's passenger EV sales will reach 620,800 units by 2030, eventually climbing to 5.2 million annually by 2040. The transition is modeled on market forces rather than policy interventions. Sales are on track to surpass 305,000 units this year, a 42 percent increase over 2025.

stories.title: India’s passenger EVs projected to rise to 10.2 percent of total sales by 2030
stories.summary: Passenger EV sales in India are expected to hit 620,800 units by 2030, according to a BloombergNEF report. Annual sales are projected to reach 5.2 million by 2040 under an economic transition model. For 2026, sales are expected to exceed 305,000 units, a 42 percent increase from 2025.

Multimodal freight proposed as solution to road congestion
stories.summary: Road freight currently dominates Indian logistics, but the model is increasingly capital and emissions intensive. TCI Group suggests the future lies in integrating highways with railways, ports and inland waterways. The industry is now looking for ways to move goods without relying solely on trucks.

stories.title: Mahindra launches compact harvester for small farms
stories.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra has launched the Harvest Yuva, a 50HP compact harvester designed for small and marginal landholdings. The machine features a narrow width to navigate restricted approach roads. The company says the harvester is affordable and adaptable, aiming to improve income potential for small-scale farmers.

stories.title: Montra Electric deploys e-tractors at Action TESA facility
stories.summary: Montra Electric has deployed seven E-45 electric tractors at Action TESA's manufacturing plant in Visakhapatnam. The move aims to integrate electric mobility into the MDF manufacturing sector. Action TESA is evaluating the electric tractors as a cleaner alternative to conventional industrial material-handling equipment.

stories.title: Visteon expands cellular module production in Chennai
stories.summary: Visteon Corporation has opened a new production line for Cellular Network Access Device modules at its Chennai plant. The investment is intended to strengthen the company's regional supply chain. Visteon says the site will now serve as a manufacturing base for cellular technology for its global customers.

stories.title: SKF secures BIS licences for Ahmedabad facility
stories.summary: SKF in India has received Bureau of Indian Standards licences to manufacture Spherical Roller Bearings and Deep Groove Ball Bearings at its Ahmedabad plant. The company secured the certification on its first attempt. SKF says it now aims to obtain similar quality certifications across its other facilities.

stories.title: Birla Carbon opens manufacturing plant in Thailand
stories.summary: Birla Carbon has opened a 120 kMT carbon black plant in Rayong, Thailand. The facility will produce materials for tyres and mechanical rubber goods. The company says the location will lower logistics costs and improve supply chain efficiency by placing production closer to key regional customers.

stories.title: Zimmermann expands brake disc range
stories.summary: Otto Zimmermann GmbH has added new Formula:S steel-hub brake discs for Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover and Jaguar models. The company also introduced a cross-drilled version and matching reduced-dust pads. Zimmermann claims the steel-hub design reduces unsprung mass while maintaining thermal stability.

stories.title: Schaeffler targets motorcycle aftermarket in Philippines
stories.summary: Schaeffler Philippines showcased its Vehicle Lifetime Solutions portfolio at the 2026 Manila Auto Salon. The company announced plans to expand its motorcycle aftermarket business, providing repair and replacement components. The program is intended to help repair professionals and distributors meet maintenance requirements for various vehicle makes.

stories.title: Automotive pressure plate market faces dual demand structure
stories.summary: The global automotive pressure plate market is defined by a split between low-volume Original Equipment programs and high-volume Independent Aftermarket replacement demand. A new IndexBox report notes that the market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a more regionally diversified supply architecture.

stories.title: In-vehicle connectivity shifts toward software platforms
stories.summary: The in-vehicle connectivity market is transitioning from hardware-centric components to software-enabled platforms for software-defined vehicles. A new IndexBox report suggests the market is moving toward more disciplined procurement and regionally diversified supply chains as it evolves through 2035.

stories.title: Hyundai to increase vehicle prices in December
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India will raise prices on select models by up to ₹8,000 starting December 1, 2026. The company cited rising input costs as the primary reason for the revision. Hyundai noted it has been absorbing expenses through operational efficiencies until now.

stories.title: Tata Motors and Audi join year-end price hikes
stories.summary: Tata Motors and Audi India have announced price increases following a similar move by Maruti Suzuki. Tata Motors will raise prices by an average of 0.5 percent from December 1, while Audi will increase prices by up to 2 percent from January 1. Both cited rising input costs.

Automakers announce December price revisions
stories.summary: Tata Motors, Hyundai and Audi have announced price hikes effective December 1, 2026. Companies cited sustained inflation in commodity costs and global supply-chain pressures. The revisions affect various passenger vehicle portfolios, with Tata Motors increasing prices by an average of 0.5 percent and Hyundai by up to ₹8,000.

stories.title: Audi India schedules second price hike for January
stories.summary: Audi India will increase prices by up to 2 percent across its portfolio starting January 1, 2027. The company cited rising input costs and the need for long-term business sustainability. This follows a similar price increase implemented by the luxury automaker on April 1, 2026.

stories.title: Tata Motors announces fourth price hike of fiscal year
stories.summary: Tata Motors will raise prices on its cars and SUVs by an average of 0.5 percent starting December 1, 2026. The increase applies to both internal combustion and electric vehicles. The company said the move is intended to partially offset elevated input costs.

stories.title: Tata Motors reports quarterly loss despite revenue growth
stories.summary: Tata Motors reported a 34 percent year-on-year revenue increase to ₹96,920 crore for Q2FY27. However, the company posted a net loss of ₹5,451 crore due to restructuring and impairment charges. The results highlight a divergence between Jaguar Land Rover recovery and domestic passenger vehicle margin pressures.

stories.title: Foreign investors return to India with ₹1 lakh crore in November
stories.summary: Foreign portfolio investors have purchased over ₹1 lakh crore in Indian shares since the start of November. This follows a period where investors pulled ₹3.6 lakh crore from the market between January and October. Enthusiasm for overseas artificial intelligence stocks has cooled, prompting a shift in capital.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz reports Q3 profit pressure despite revenue
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz reported €30.7 billion in revenue and €1.77 billion in operating profit for the third quarter of 2026. Adjusted operating profit fell by 15 percent, as the company faces weaker demand in China and margin pressure. Profitability remains under pressure despite growth in electric vehicles.

stories.title: Andrews Automotive Group acquires two Georgia dealerships
stories.summary: Andrews Automotive Group has acquired Flowers Honda and Flowers Nissan in Thomasville, Georgia. The deal closed on November 3, marking the group's first expansion into the Honda and Nissan brands. The company previously operated only three Stellantis stores. The car business moves fast.

stories.title: Automotive industry shifts AI from pilot to production
stories.summary: Automotive manufacturers are deploying AI across vehicle development, manufacturing, and in-vehicle systems. As autonomous agents take on decision-making roles previously reserved for humans, companies face increased legal and operational exposure. The industry is now navigating product liability and warranty risks alongside emerging AI-specific laws.

stories.title: co-pace hosts Automotive AI Startup Innovation Challenge
stories.summary: AUMOVIO's startup organization, co-pace, recently hosted an innovation challenge at Newlab Detroit to connect startups with the company. The event focused on AI technologies for software-defined and AI-enabled vehicles. Managing director Dr. Otmar Schreiner noted that innovation and connectivity are intertwined.

stories.summary: The Environment Ministry has amended vehicle scrapping rules to exempt automakers from recording estimated future recycling costs as liabilities. stories.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has revised Pollution Under Control certificate validity based on vehicle age and emission norms. New BS6 vehicles up to six years old now require testing every three years. BS4 vehicles must be tested every six months.

stories.title: EV battery recyclers face market shift
stories.summary: Two major Canadian EV battery recyclers have filed for bankruptcy in the past two years. While recycling struggles, companies like Moment Energy are building megafactories to repurpose used vehicle batteries for energy storage. The industry is finding that old batteries have uses beyond the scrap heap.

stories.title: India leads energy efficiency gains
stories.summary: India is projected to improve its energy intensity by more than 4 percent in 2026, outpacing the global average of 3 percent.
